title: What Your Regulars' Orders Say About Them

scenes.say: Tell me your usual, and I'll tell you who you are.
Black drip, no lid? Up since five. Oat flat white? Has a nine o'clock meeting. And the new seasonal special? Here for the photo, and honestly, that's great.

props.caption: What the order *says*
items: Black drip, no lid: up since 5
Oat flat white: has a 9 am

scenes.speaker: Maria
scenes.say: And the best usual of all? When I walk in, and it's already being made.
What's your usual? Tell me in the comments. Follow for more cafe life.
